messages:
Alex K: Morning handoff — quick summary of the incident last night and current status.

Alex K: TL;DR: 23:12–02:10 UTC we had intermittent 429s impacting embeddings and some generation calls in eu-west. Root cause appears to be the dedicated autoscaler failing to spin up extra nodes during a sudden traffic spike; resulted in queue growth and token throttles.

Alex K: Impact: several enterprise customers saw increased latency and occasional 429s for embedding routes. No data loss. Some background batch jobs retried.

svc:oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INC-2026-2243 — "eu-west dedicated autoscaler spike". Pages sent to primary (Jordan T) at 23:15 UTC. Pagerlog: 3 pages, 2 acknowledges.

Jordan T: i handled the first page, started manual scale at 23:22 (scaled pool+2). Saw queue length spike in kafka-proxy. Routing fallback to secondary region reduced errors for most tenants.

Jordan T: mitigation steps taken:
- manually scaled dedicated pool (pool-rt-3)
- enabled fallback routing for embeddings to us-west for non-data-resident tenants
- kicked off cache-warmup for model kv cache

Jordan T: Observed metrics after manual scale: 99th latency dropped from ~18s to ~1.4s over ~6 minutes. Error rate fell to baseline by 23:40.

Priya S: i triaged logs around 00:10 — autoscaler loop was throwing 503s when calling compute-provisioner; looks like intermittent auth failures (403) causing backoff. Patch queued to staging.

Maria L: linked a quick reproduction and patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3291

Alex K: Current status as of handoff: stable. Autoscaler patch deployed to prod at 04:50 UTC in a limited canary across eu-west-1a. No further 429s observed since 04:55. Rolling canary scheduled for 05:30.

Alex K: Coverage note: primary for next shift is Priya S, secondary is Alex K. However Priya is partially unavailable 03:00–05:00 UTC (travel). There's a coverage gap between 03:00–05:00 unless Alex covers. Priya confirmed she'll be reachable by phone for paging but not Zoom. Marking as action item.

Priya S: i'm reachable by phone and pager; if anything spikes past baseline please call. I'll have delayed Slack responses from airport.

Alex K: If Priya doesn't ack a page during 03:00–05:00, standard escalation: page secondary (Alex), then on-call manager (SRE Lead) if >2 pages in 5m.

svc:oncall-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-autoscaler — follow 'manual-scale' and 'fallback-routing' sections.

Alex K: Quick checks for next shift (commands):
```sh
# check autoscaler health
curl -s https://internal-metrics.redwood/autoscaler/eu-west/healthz
# queue length
kc get --namespace=prod kafka/ingest-queue -o json | jq '.status.length'
# scale command
infra scale pool-rt-3 --replicas 6
```

Jordan T: logs to watch: autoscaler controller logs (controller.log), compute-provisioner auth errors (auth.log). If you see 403 -> check provisioning service account creds rotated recently.

Maria L: Postmortem plan: small blameless postmortem draft by EOD. Include timeline, root cause, mitigation, rollforward plan, customer notification draft.

Alex K: Customer comms: CX draft in #customer-success; flagged customer list in the incident doc. Priya pls review before we send.

Priya S: Will review around 06:00 UTC and sign off.

Alex K: Next steps for incoming shift:
- confirm canary rollout at 05:30 completed
- verify no 4xx/5xx trends in the last 2 hours
- run the regression eval for embedding quality (ensure fallback didn't change model variant)
- collect billing spike numbers for impacted window
- follow up on PR 3291 and scheduling a postmortem meeting

Alex K: Anything else? :thumbsup:

Jordan T: add a note to rota: avoid scheduling travel across 02:00–06:00 for primary/secondary pairing for eu-west until autoscaler fix fully verified.

Alex K: ack. i'll update rota and calendar.

svc:oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2243 status -> MONITORING. Tags: autoscaler, eu-west, embeddings, mitigation-applied.

Alex K: handing off to Priya and incoming day team. I'll be reachable if pages escalate. Good handoff.

Priya S: thanks — taking primary at 06:00 UTC. leaving this thread pinned for next steps.
